newsitem.title: FRANCE: French privatisation stocks plunge on poll.
newsitem.headline: French privatisation stocks plunge on poll.

text.p: Shares in companies the current government plans to privatise but whose future could be affected by a possible left win in the parliamentary election fell sharply on Monday on the back of first-round results.
Traders said the market fears the state asset sales may be postponed on cancelled by a government of the Socialist and Communist parties.
Dassault Aviation, slated to merge with state-owned Aerospatiale, was suspended limit down at the opening at its lower limit of 1,112 francs. It closed at 1,230 on Friday.
Dassault Electronique , which would merge with Thomson-CSF in the case Alcatel Alsthom wins the bidding for the state's 58 percent stake in Thomson-CSF, was down 6.95 percent at 549 francs at midday.
Thomson-CSF itself was down 6.07 percent at 178 francs.
Lagardere, the other bidder for Thomson-CSF, was 4.64 percent down at 176.70. Alcatel fell 2.65 percent to 662 francs.
Credit Lyonnais was down 5.62 percent at 220 francs.
Bull was down 3.05 percent at 44.50, after a low of 43.50 francs. The state recentlty cut its stake in the computer group to 17 percent and is expected to sell more shares at a later stage.
